[**Smaug-Decisions: State-of-the-Art Audio Decisions in a 4B Model That Also Sees and Reads**](https://blog.abacus.ai/blog/2026/11/02/smaug-decisions)

Smaug-Decisions is an open 4B model that answers typed questions about audio, images and text with a calibrated probability per option, in one forward pass. It beats Gemini 4 Argon on audio decisions, and its 3.45 GB phone build runs offline on an iPhone GPU.

Neural architecture search (NAS) is a popular area of machine learning, with the goal of automating the development of the best neural network for a given dataset.
